newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet pleased by court biscuit decision.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet pleased by court biscuit decision.

text.p: Food and drink company Grand Metropolitan Plc said on Tuesday it was pleased with a decision by the high court to rule in favour of United Biscuits (Holding) against supermarket chain ASDA Group Plc.

GrandMet will take a case against Asda in June that four of its cheaper supermarket own label brands -- Daniel Boone's, Deep South, ASDA Peach Schnapps and Windward -- could be mistaken for GrandMet's branded equivalent.
Justice Walker ruled earlier today that ASDA was guiltly of "passing off" and its Puffin biscuit presentation was "deceptively similar" to UB's Penguin biscuits.
"We are pleased that the judgement came down substantially in favour of the brand owmer. Particularly in view of the fact that the passing off was upheld against Asda," said a GrandMet spokesman.
"We feel as a result of our strong passing off case we will be utlimately successful," said the GrandMet spokesman. -- London newsroom + 44 171 542 7717
